Why contractors like us exist

The gap between a contract and a cargo

Large buyers often hand sourcing to procurement firms. Those firms then need someone on the ground who can find material, prepare it, clear it and deliver it. That is our role.

One point of accountability

Instead of coordinating miners, laboratories, brokers and carriers separately, you work with one contractor under one agreement.

Verification you control

Your appointed independent inspector can sample and test before release. We do not ask you to trust our word alone.

Your client stays yours

When you subcontract to us, we agree in writing not to approach your end buyer. Confidentiality terms are available before you share details.

Execution capability

One contractor, four services

  1. SourceSecure material at origin and confirm it exists.
  2. ProcessRefine, sort or blend to the buyer’s specification.
  3. DocumentAssemble permits, assays and chain-of-custody records.
  4. ShipMove it to the agreed port, airport or vault.

How an engagement runs

A clear, documented path from origin to delivery

Every mandate follows the same four stages. Engage us for the full chain or for a single stage. Select a stage to see how it differs by commodity.

Stage 01 / Origin

Sourcing and verification of supply

Origin allocation, ownership checks and baseline sampling, so the material and the right to sell it are real before you commit.

Read the full service detail
Rare earths
Off-take from licensed operations, with baseline sampling at source.
Crude oil
Allocation lifting from producers, terminals and tank farms.
Gemstones
Rough parcels from licensed producers and tenders, sealed and recorded.
Stage 02 / Specification

Processing to specification

Beneficiation, refining, blending, sorting or cutting to the buyer’s technical requirements before export.

Read the full service detail
Rare earths
Crushing, milling, separation and chemical processing through partner plants.
Crude oil
Terminal blending, water and sediment treatment, gravity and sulphur alignment.
Gemstones
Cleaning, sorting, grading, sawing, cutting and polishing.
Stage 03 / Dossier

Documentation and compliance

Permits, assay reports, provenance records and banking documents, assembled so cargo can be cleared and financed.

See the document set
Origin & permits
Certificates of origin, export licences, royalty and tax clearance.
Inspection
Assay, quality and quantity reports from the surveyor you appoint.
Provenance & banking
Chain-of-custody records, invoices, packing lists and bills of lading.
Stage 04 / Delivery

Logistics and delivery

Chartering, containers or secured air transport, with insurance, and the chain of custody kept intact until handover.

Read the full service detail
Crude oil
Vessel chartering support, ship-to-ship coordination and discharge management.
Rare earths & bulk
Sealed drums and bulk bags in containers, with hazardous-goods clearance where needed.
Gemstones
Courier or vault-to-vault secured air transport, with insurance.
